description: CAISO (California ISO) grid today, from its Today's Outlook data: latest 5-minute generation by source (solar, wind, geothermal, biomass, biogas, small and large hydro, coal, nuclear, natural gas, batteries, imports, other) in MW with renewable share, current demand with day-ahead and hour-ahead forecasts, net load (demand minus solar and wind — the duck curve) for every 5-minute interval so far, and today's peak solar and minimum net load. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: energy_caiso_california_iso
title: Energy Caiso California Iso
